name: logo
label: Logo
help_text: Displayed in the white logo badge at the top of the hero.

name: show_eyebrow
label: Show eyebrow text
help_text: OPTIONAL EXTRA (not one of the 7 original bullets). Toggles the eyebrow line on/off without deleting its text.

name: eyebrow_text
label: Eyebrow text
help_text: Small label above the H1. Only shown when "Show eyebrow text" is on.

name: heading
label: Heading (H1)
help_text: Renders as the page's real <h1>. Keep it plain text (no formatting) for accessibility and consistent styling.

name: intro_copy
label: Introductory copy
default: See your impact, compare partner packages, and build a plan tailored to your brand.
help_text: Short supporting paragraph under the H1. Rich text so an editor can bold/link a phrase if needed, but keep it to 1-2 sentences.

name: nav_items
label: Navigation items

children.name: link
children.label: Link
children.help_text: Point this at an in-page anchor (e.g. #packages) if the target section is on the same page, or a full URL otherwise.

help_text: One entry per nav pill. Reorder by dragging; add up to 8.

name: accent_color
label: Accent color
help_text: OPTIONAL EXTRA (not one of the 7 original bullets). Tints the CTA button and the soft glow behind the hero. Leave default if unsure.
